intro.title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that determines if an array of numbers can be split into two subsets with equal sums. You will learn the core concept of dynamic programming, which solves complex problems by breaking them down into simpler overlapping subproblems. The main technologies involved are JavaScript arrays, loops, and conditional logic to implement a solution step-by-step. This beginner-friendly lesson will guide you through understanding the problem and implementing an efficient algorithm.
intro.usecase: The Partition Equal Subset Sum algorithm solves resource allocation problems where you need to split items into two balanced groups. In e-commerce, this helps optimize warehouse storage by dividing products equally between two shipping containers to minimize space waste. Data analysts use it to create balanced A/B testing groups with similar total user engagement metrics. Financial platforms apply it to split investment portfolios into two funds with nearly identical total values for risk diversification.
